history: Urumqi means 'beautiful pasture'; the Qing built Dihua city here and the old name returned in 1954. It is one of the world's largest cities farthest from the ocean; Heavenly Lake of Tianshan hangs like a mirror between snow peaks. The Grand Bazaar's spices, dried fruits and music brew Central-Asian flavor; baked buns and pilaf are daily life.
importance: Capital of Xinjiang · Geographic center of Asia
foods: Shawan big-plate chicken with belt noodles.
Naan-oven baked buns — crispy shell, fragrant meat.
Lamb pilaf with carrot, glossy and aromatic.
Over-oil meat noodles — chewy and strong.
Sesame and scallion naan — the traveler's pocket bread.
Red-willow skewers with cumin and chili.
Xinjiang-style yogurt with honey and zongzi.
Fermented mare's milk of the steppe.
scenes: The Jade Pool legend — snow peaks over an emerald lake.
Red Mountain's pagoda overlooks the whole city.
The Loulan beauty mummy and the 'Five Stars Rise in the East' brocade.
Petrified wood and the heavenly horses.
The windmill city of the song.
